name: Now-How-Wow Matrix
deliverable: Idea classification across feasibility (Now), breakthrough (How), and original (Wow)

steps.text: Post three columns, Now, How, and Wow, and define each in one sentence before anything is sorted.
Read every idea aloud once without debate so the group hears the whole set before judging any of it.
Sort each idea: Now if today's means can deliver it, How if it needs a route, Wow if it changes the offer.
For each How item, write the missing capability or experiment that would move it toward Now.
Choose one Now to schedule, one How to investigate, and one Wow to prototype, each with an owner.

failure: Everything drifts into Wow, the room celebrates novelty, and no idea gets a route, a test, or an owner.
intervention: Ask what the idea would take to run next week. Without an answer it stays in How until a named experiment exists.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: Widely used in innovation workshops; no single documented originator.
